name: 15-Minute Cyclic Sighing
title: Practice 15 minutes of cyclic sighing.
subtitle: Breathing Practice
rationale: Emphasizing the exhale shifts the nervous system toward calm faster than most other brief interventions tested.

evidence.summary: Stanford and Cell Reports Medicine research supports brief cyclic sighing practice as a stress and mood intervention.

indications: Stress stays elevated across the workday.
Mood dips need a repeatable, drug-free tool.
Brief breathwork already helps in emergencies.
